Create a polished ORIGINAL CREATURE CONCEPT ATLAS for Riptide, a hand-painted fantasy chibi RPG. This is a visual breeding catalogue: every requested cell is ONE NEW hybrid creature, visibly inheriting anatomical traits from BOTH named parents. Reference images show the existing parent species and exact visual style; use their painted shapes and palette, never copy the reference atlas layout.
EXACT OUTPUT LAYOUT: landscape 3:2 image, an INVISIBLE uniform grid of FIVE equal columns by THREE equal rows. EXACTLY FIFTEEN separate complete creatures. Read the assignments in row-major order: row1 left-to-right cells01-05, row2 cells06-10, row3 cells11-15. Each creature occupies only its own cell and stays centered with at least 20 percent transparent clearance on EVERY side. Entire tails, horns, antlers, paws and wings must fit within that cell. No extras, no empty cells, no overlap. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA BACKGROUND outside the silhouettes. No scene, no terrain, no white matte, no checkerboard, no visible grid, NO LETTERING or labels or numbers. Labels will be added by code.
STYLE: match the supplied original Riptide Tides: beautiful hand-painted storybook fantasy sprites, bold clean dark-brown ink outlines, warm modeled painterly highlights, detailed fur/feathers/scales, large expressive heads, short sturdy chibi proportions, powerful readable silhouettes, cool mutated fantasy animals. A range of charming to fierce, no gore. Full-body three-quarter SIDE VIEW, head facing RIGHT, tail left; anatomically connected single head/body, grounded feet or a clearly intentional floating pose. Restrained magical body highlights, no huge glow clouds or floor shadows. Six-limbed fantasy creatures only where a specified wing pair or insect anatomy needs it. Balanced inheritance, not an original animal simply recolored.

STRICT PLACEMENT: Creature centers are at x=10%,30%,50%,70%,90% of the image and y=16.67%,50%,83.33%. Each creature including every appendage fits within just 60% of its own cell width and 70% of its own cell height. Transparent gutters between every pair of neighbors are essential. Do not enlarge a creature to fill its entire cell. Match these fifteen independent center points precisely.

CELL 01 (row 1, column 1): Acorn Boar + Rune Stag. Give a sturdy boar chest four longer stag legs and dark cloven hooves. A deer brow with branching wooden antlers slopes into a short tusked rooting muzzle. Chestnut bristles carry mint rune channels, and a cream deer throat tuft joins the bristled chest; keep a short curled boar tail.
CELL 02 (row 1, column 2): Acorn Boar + Coral Drake. Make a stocky coral drake with a flattened boar snout, broad ivory tusks and a bristled cheek ruff. Four short clawed legs support its barrel torso; coral wings and sea-green fins grow from the shoulders. A long curled scaled tail retains a tiny bristle tuft, with piglet stripes visible between coral plates.
CELL 03 (row 1, column 3): Acorn Boar + Dawn Phoenix. Fuse a boar sturdy barrel chest and tusked rooting muzzle with a phoenix sharp hooked upper beak and broad golden wings. Brown bristles transition into orange feather quills along its spine. Four stout legs end in hooked hooflike claws, and a compact fan of flame feathers replaces the curled tail.
CELL 04 (row 1, column 4): Acorn Boar + Obsidian Bear. Create a heavy bear with towering shoulders and enormous clawed forepaws, a boar barrel belly and stout cloven hind feet. Its broad muzzle ends in a rooting nose flanked by ivory tusks. Charcoal fur and brown bristles grow between natural obsidian back plates, with a short curled bristle tail.
CELL 05 (row 1, column 5): Acorn Boar + Aurora Kirin. Combine a kirin arched neck, pearly horn and four graceful cloven hooves with a compact boar torso and blunt tusked muzzle. Lilac scales emerge through brown striped bristles, while a pastel flowing mane follows the spine. A short curled boar tail extends into mint-pink silky strands.
CELL 06 (row 2, column 1): Acorn Boar + Spectral Panther. Design a crouched spectral panther with wide feline paws and a long curved tail, but a boar powerful barrel hindbody and flattened tusked muzzle. Sapphire bristles form a raised shoulder ridge, pale cyan stripes crossing its translucent flanks. Rounded pig ears blend into pointed feline rims above fierce narrow eyes.
CELL 07 (row 2, column 2): Acorn Boar + Spectral Wyrm. Fuse a heavy boar shoulder barrel and four short split-hoof feet with an elongated serpentine dragon neck and full curling tail. The horned head has a broad rooting nose and ivory side tusks. Brown bristles along the shoulder spine transition smoothly into translucent sapphire scales and pale cyan fins.
CELL 08 (row 2, column 3): Ember Cub + Moon Owl. Fuse a lion cub torso and padded hind paws with feathered owl forelimbs ending in curved talons. A silver owl facial disk surrounds a short feline muzzle and hooked beak tip. Midnight wings emerge behind an ember feather mane, while a tufted lion tail stays fully visible.
CELL 09 (row 2, column 4): Ember Cub + Crystal Gecko. Give a fiery lion cub a longer gecko torso and curled scaled tail, keeping its rounded feline cheeks and small ember mane. Four broad feet separate into lavender adhesive toes beneath furry ankles. Turquoise crystal spines grow through orange shoulder fur and continue into the tail flame tuft.
CELL 10 (row 2, column 5): Ember Cub + Storm Lynx. Combine a young lion broad chest and small red mane with a lynx long springing hindlegs, large snowshoe paws and tall black ear tufts. A short bobtail sprouts a compact ember plume. Grey flank fur carries fine cyan streaks that branch into the warm mane roots.
CELL 11 (row 3, column 1): Ember Cub + Cinder Wolf. Merge a lion cub round chest, padded forepaws and cheek mane with a wolf long fanged muzzle, tall pointed ears and springy hindlegs. Two distinct mane layers form a compact circular lion ruff and a swept canine dorsal crest. The long brush tail ends in a dense ember tuft.
CELL 12 (row 3, column 2): Ember Cub + Frost Ibex. Build a sturdy young lion with two swept crystalline ibex horns growing above rounded feline ears. Padded front paws and cloven back hooves support a compact goatlike barrel. White wool forms the lower beard, while orange ember mane strands curve around icy horn bases; a small tufted tail remains clear.
CELL 13 (row 3, column 3): Ember Cub + Sunmane. Create a compact powerful lion with oversized cub paws, short sturdy limbs and mature Sunmane jaw muscles. Its mane has two anatomically distinct layers: a tight inner ember ruff and broad outer golden cheek fins sweeping backward like rays. The lion tail has a forked double tuft echoing both mane layers.
CELL 14 (row 3, column 4): Ember Cub + Rune Stag. Combine a lion cub chest, small ember mane and rounded feline muzzle with a stag branching antlers and long cloven hindlegs. Broad padded forepaws remain lionlike. Mint rune channels trace the chestnut flanks between short orange fur, while the elongated neck and cream throat transition naturally into the mane.
CELL 15 (row 3, column 5): Ember Cub + Coral Drake. Make a compact feline dragon with broad lion cub paws, an orange ember mane and a short fanged muzzle. Coral horns grow through the mane and small teal membrane wings attach at the shoulders. Coral scales blend into furry hips, continuing along a fully curled dragon tail tipped with ember fur.
